Extraction.name: Input Registered Sample
Extraction.description: Registered Sample in the platform used as input for the protocol.

Extraction.name: Extraction Protocol
Extraction.description: Describe the procedures and protocols used to prepare the specimen or sample for analysis. This includes details on how the sample was collected, treated, processed, and preserved, ensuring reproducibility and clarity for downstream analyses.

Extraction.name: Extract Name
Extraction.description: User-defined names for each portion of extracted material.

Extraction.name: Post Extraction
Extraction.description: Extract concentration, Samples enrichment and resuspension processes e.g Dried under nitrogen, resuspended in H2O or pyridine, SPE column

Extraction.name: Label
Extraction.description: Indicates a chemical or biological marker, such as a radioactive isotope or a fluorescent dye which is bound to a material in order to make it detectable by some assay technology (e.g. P33, biotin, GFP).

Chromatography.name: Input Registered Sample
Chromatography.description: Registered Sample in the platform used as input for the protocol.

Chromatography.name: Separation Protocol
Chromatography.description: Describe the procedures and protocols used to separate the components of the specimen or sample for analysis.

Chromatography.name: Output name
Chromatography.description: User-defined name for the output of the chromatography separation protocol.

Chromatography.name: Column model
Chromatography.description: Model or make of the of Column used, e.g C18

Chromatography.name: Column type
Chromatography.description: Type of Chromatography used e.g reverse phase

Chromatography.name: Autosampler model
Chromatography.description: Model or make of the autosampler used

Chromatography.name: Guard column model
Chromatography.description: Model or make of the guard column used

Chromatography.name: Detector model
Chromatography.description: If relevant, Model or make of the detector used during chromatography separation

Chromatography.name: Detector Temperature
Chromatography.description: If relevant, temperature of the detector (e.g. FID) used during chromatography separation

Chromatography.name: Signal range of the detector
Chromatography.description: If relevant, signal range of the detector (e.g. DAD) used during chromatography separation

Chromatography.name: Resolution of the detector
Chromatography.description: If relevant, resolution of the detector (e.g. DAD) used during chromatography separation

Chromatography_extended.name: Input Registered Sample
Chromatography_extended.description: Registered Sample in the platform used as input for the protocol.

Chromatography_extended.name: Separation Protocol
Chromatography_extended.description: Describe the procedures and protocols used to separate the components of the specimen or sample for analysis.

Chromatography_extended.name: Output name
Chromatography_extended.description: User-defined name for the output of the chromatography separation protocol.

Chromatography_extended.name: Column model
Chromatography_extended.description: Model or make of the of Column used, e.g C18

Chromatography_extended.name: Column type
Chromatography_extended.description: Type of Chromatography used e.g reverse phase

Chromatography_extended.name: Mobile phase
Chromatography_extended.description: Composition of the mobile phase used for chromatography separation, e.g. 0.1% formic acid in water

Chromatography_extended.name: Gradient profile setting
Chromatography_extended.description: The profile of the ratio of solvents in the mobile phase used over the course of a chromatographic separation. Use notation whereby relative proportions of the eluents at a specific time point are separated by “/”, e.g. “10/90 at 1 min”. Different time points are separated by a comma. Include re-equilibration times. Example: '0/100 at 0 min, 100/0 at 6 min, 0/100 at 7 min, 0/100 at 10 min'

Chromatography_extended.name: Flow rate
Chromatography_extended.description: Flow rate of the mobile phase during chromatography separation, e.g. 0.3 mL/min

Chromatography_extended.name: Column temperature
Chromatography_extended.description: Temperature of the column during chromatography separation, e.g. 40 °C

Chromatography_extended.name: Autosampler model
Chromatography_extended.description: Model or make of the autosampler used

Chromatography_extended.name: Guard column model
Chromatography_extended.description: Model or make of the guard column used

Chromatography_extended.name: Detector model
Chromatography_extended.description: If relevant, model or make of the detector used during chromatography separation

Chromatography_extended.name: Detector Temperature
Chromatography_extended.description: If relevant, temperature of the detector (e.g. FID) used during chromatography separation

Chromatography_extended.name: Signal range of the detector
Chromatography_extended.description: If relevant, signal range of the detector (e.g. DAD) used during chromatography separation

Chromatography_extended.name: Resolution of the detector
Chromatography_extended.description: If relevant, resolution of the detector (e.g. DAD) used during chromatography separation

Mass spectrometry.name: Input Registered Sample
Mass spectrometry.description: Registered Sample in the platform used as input for the protocol.

Mass spectrometry.name: Spectrometry Protocol
Mass spectrometry.description: Describe the procedures and protocols used for mass spectrometry analysis of the specimen or sample.

Mass spectrometry.name: MS Data File Name
Mass spectrometry.description: User-defined name for the MS assay sample.

Mass spectrometry.name: Scan polarity
Mass spectrometry.description: An acquisition mode to which specifies weather polarity is negative, positive or alternating.

Mass spectrometry.name: Scan m/z range
Mass spectrometry.description: The limit of m/z over which a mass spectrometer can detect ions. e.g 200-1000

Mass spectrometry.name: Spectrometry Instrument
Mass spectrometry.description: The name of the mass spectrometry instrument, manufacturer, model # operational software name operational software version

Mass spectrometry.name: Ion source
Mass spectrometry.description: The ion source use PSI-MS controlled vocabulary. Ionization mode (EI, APCI, ESI#), vacuum pressure skimmer/focusing lens voltages (e.g. capillary voltage etc.) gas flows (e.g. nebulization gas, cone gas etc.) source temperature

Mass spectrometry.name: Mass analyzer
Mass spectrometry.description: The analyzer(s) used by the mass spectrometer, use PSI-MS controlled vocabulary

Mass spectrometry.name: Raw Spectral Data File
Mass spectrometry.description: Name (or URI) of the raw spectral data file generated by an assay.

Metabolite identification.name: Input Registered Sample
Metabolite identification.description: Registered Sample in the platform used as input for the protocol.

Metabolite identification.name: Data Transformation Name
Metabolite identification.description: Describe the procedures and protocols used for mass spectrometry analysis of the specimen or sample.

Metabolite identification.name: Derived Spectral Data File Name
Metabolite identification.description: Name of the derived data file generated from spectral data by an assay.

Metabolite identification.name: Normalization Name
Metabolite identification.description: User-defined name for each normalization applied

Metabolite identification.name: Metabolite Assignment File
Metabolite identification.description: Name (or URI) of the metabolite assignment file gathered for this assay.

NMR sample.name: NMR tube type
NMR sample.description: e.g. 5 mm conventional, Shigemi, mircocell etc.

NMR sample.name: Temperature
NMR sample.description: Sample temperature run in the magnet, in Kelvin

NMR sample.name: Label
NMR sample.description: Indicates a chemical or biological marker or observed nucleus

NMR spectroscopy.name: Instrument
NMR spectroscopy.description: Name and model of the NMR instrument, e.g. Bruker Avance III, ...

NMR spectroscopy.name: NMR Probe
NMR spectroscopy.description: Type of probe fitted to the spectroscope e.g. 10mm 31P, 5mm HCN coldprobe, 3mm flow-probe, etc.

NMR spectroscopy.name: Number of transients
NMR spectroscopy.description: Number of transients (scan) acquired for your experiment. e.g 128 or 256

NMR spectroscopy.name: Pulse sequence name
NMR spectroscopy.description: Pulse sequence used to acquire the data, noesypr1d

NMR spectroscopy.name: Magnetic field strength
NMR spectroscopy.description: a parameter expressed in tesla to report the strength of the field e.g 14.1 T Varian Inova ; 18.8 T Bruker Avance

NMR spectroscopy.name: Acquisition Parameter Data File
NMR spectroscopy.description: Name (or URI) of the acquisition parameter data file gathered for this assay.

NMR assay.name: NMR Assay Name
NMR assay.description: User-defined name for a NMR assay.

NMR assay.name: Free Induction Decay Data File
NMR assay.description: Name (or URI) of the free induction decay data file gathered for this assay.
